# GFM features

## A table with mixed alignment

| Left | Centre | Right |
|:-----|:------:|------:|
| a    | b      | c     |
| longer cell | x | 12345 |

## A task list

- [x] a finished task
- [ ] an unfinished task

## Deeply nested lists

- one
  - two
    - three
      - four
        - five

## A blockquote containing a list

> Quoted text.
>
> - first
> - second
>
> More quoted text.

## Code blocks

```rust
fn main() {
    println!("hello");
}
```
